analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: Russell 3000 breadth is weak, with 37% of stocks above their 200dma. Flushes to 20% or below have often marked attractive entries in secular uptrends, but that level has not been reached.
The share of S&P 500 stocks at fresh 4-week lows has not hit the -50% threshold that has often signalled a tradeable low. A deeper breadth washout may still be needed.
S&P 500 RSI is oversold and fewer than 10% of stocks are above their 10dma. 50dma breadth is 42%, while a full flush typically takes it to 10-20%.
The S&P 500 put/call ratio is elevated, matching March, June and year-end levels, but remains well below the panic readings tied to major lows.
The S&P 500 decisively broke 7,000 support after a poor week. Reclaiming 7,000 is key, and the next notable support is the gap at 6,618.
VIX can still move higher, and readings above 35 often signal an equity low is near. Friday's close near the highs warrants caution and a watch for reversal.
The 2026 S&P 500 path is being compared with 2018, when weakness extended into December before a rebound. The analogue is worth monitoring but is not a roadmap.
Korea, memory and semis have had deeper initial drawdowns than ARKK in 2021. Even if a low is in, the bigger risk is prolonged sideways action or further downside.

sector_views.rationale: Drawdowns exceed ARKK 2021 analogue, with risk of prolonged sideways action or further downside even if a low is in.
